items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I used to do a slapstick on, uh, on the Handy Band, on Memphis Blues.

ctx.x: When did you start with those washboards? After you hit Chicago, that kind of music? No. Or have you ever played that in the minstrel days, too, or?

No, I got that the same time I started a slapstick. I used to do a slapstick on, uh, on the Handy Band, on Memphis Blues. Like you see them all applaud, I mean, uh, clap hands. Yeah, on the offbeat? Yeah, well I, I, uh, was on a wood pile down in Mississippi. We were on a date down there. And I stopped by this wood pile and I picked up an old washboard and I picked up, uh, two, uh, flat boards. And I put a leather on one end. I said, this guy, they came to me and said, instead of clapping my hand, I'm gonna clap…
